description:
INSPECTION: View the current infrastructure stack for a session
Returns the current state of the user's infrastructure design including:

**Components** - Selected infrastructure services (VPC, databases, caching, etc.)
  • Shows what services the user has chosen (e.g., PostgreSQL, Redis, S3)
  • Includes architecture decisions (EKS vs EC2, monolith vs microservices)

**Config** - Configuration details for each component
  • Database sizes, replica counts, storage amounts
  • Cache settings, queue configurations
  • Backup schedules and retention policies

**Pricing** - Cost estimates (when available)
  • Monthly cost estimates per component
  • Total estimated monthly spend

**Phase Indicators** - Where the user is in the design workflow:
  • hasComponents: User has selected infrastructure services
  • hasConfig: User has configured component details
  • hasPricing: Cost estimates have been calculated
  • hasTerraform: Ready for Terraform generation

Use this tool when the user asks 'what is my current stack?', 'show my infrastructure', 'what have I selected?', or similar questions about their design progress.
REQUIRES: session_id from convoopen response (format: sess_v2_...).

job_id.description: Optional. Specific job ID to inspect. When omitted, returns the status of the latest job for the session.

session_id.description: Session ID from convoopen — pass back EXACTLY as returned, including the ?token=... suffix (format: sess_v2_*?token=*). The suffix is part of the session credential; never strip it when summarizing.

name: convostatus

cloudConnectionInfo.description: Cloud credential status from the backend (has_credentials, expired, cloud, auth_method, account or project ID, ...).

components.description: Selected stack components, keyed by component.

grandTotalMonthlyUSD.description: Estimated total monthly cost in US dollars, or null when there is no estimate.

hasAnyConfig.description: True when any component has configuration.

hasCloudConnection.description: True when cloud credentials are connected to the session.

hasConfig.description: True when the stack configuration is complete.

hasDeployAttempt.description: True when a deploy has been started at least once.

hasDeployment.description: True when the stack is deployed.

hasFeatures.description: True when the session has selected features.

hasPricing.description: True when a cost estimate exists.

hasSelection.description: True when the session has selected stack components.

hasTerraform.description: True when Terraform has been generated (tfgenerate).

hints.description: Guidance for the calling agent: what to do next and which tools relate to this result.

next_actions.description: Suggested next steps, in order, often as ready-to-run tool calls.

related_tools.description: Names of tools that are useful after this result.

persona.description: What InsideOut knows about the user and their target cloud.

builderIds.description: IDs of the stack builders selected for this session.

githubUsername.description: GitHub username used for deploy commit attribution.

session_id.description: Session ID this result belongs to (format sess_v2_*?token=*). Pass it back verbatim to later tools.

session_source.description: IDE or tool that opened the session (for example 'claude-code').

versioning.description: Stack version state, when the backend tracks versions.

draft_version.description: Draft version number, when a draft exists.

has_pending_changes.description: True when the draft differs from the current version.

title: View Session Stack Status
